files.README.md:
# Thimblewick Glassworks - furnace notes

Operators write a four-digit batch code at the head of every furnace note. The parsing script pulls that
code out by name so the rest of the note can be read without counting characters.

turns.prompt: Thimblewick Glassworks parses furnace notes whose first field is a batch code: exactly four digits that the parsing script must be able to read back by the name code. Give the Python regular-expression fragment that captures those four digits into a group carrying that name. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
